user.title: Set up Schedule Creator
user.description: Create the local Schedule Creator configuration. No token, YAML or helper is required.

set_profile.name: Set profile
set_profile.description: Activate or deactivate a Schedule Creator profile. Activating an exclusive profile deactivates the other exclusive ones.

active.name: Active
active.description: On to activate, off to deactivate.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On to enable, off to disable.

start_timer.name: Start Quick Timer
start_timer.description: Command a device for a while; its previous state is restored at the end.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the timer lasts (up to 7 days).

action.name: Action
action.description: Service of the device domain, e.g. turn_on, or apply_state for a desired state.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel Quick Timer
cancel_timer.description: Stop the running Quick Timer of a device and restore its previous state.
